name: Recovering an overpayment of a locked month (FR-PAY-17)
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: July was locked and paid with two days of leave that turned out to be unpaid absence. The month is never re-opened: the overpayment is recovered in August.
Two working days of a 22-day July on 22,000,000: 22,000,000 x 200 / (22 x 100) = 2,000,000 to recover.
August is an ordinary full month: BASE 22,000,000.
RETRO_RECOVERY 2,000,000 is a deduction, not a negative earning, so the payslip shows it on its own line.
It does not reduce August's taxable income: August's tax is on what August earned (the July correction is put right in the annual finalisation).
Gross = 22,000,000. Insurance on the declared base 22,000,000: BHXH 8% = 1,760,000; BHYT 1.5% = 330,000; BHTN 1% = 220,000; total 2,310,000.
PIT: 4,190,000 falls in the first bracket: 4,190,000 x 5% = 209,500.
